about: A playthrough of Thayer's Quest chosen by reading each scene (tools/scene_card.py), not by search. Each step: the button pressed, what the scene said, why this choice, what happened. The script is the cumulative button list from power-on.
goal: Find the Relics of Quoid (Druce, VTS 2 intro).

steps.scene: Attract loop, start screen, main menu (5 options; b1 = start a new game).
steps.outcome: Thayer falls through a tunnel to a hall of statues: Left Exit / Right Exit.

steps.scene: Left Exit / Right Exit, no dialogue.
steps.why: No information; a guess, as a player would.
steps.outcome: Druce: the Relics of Quoid; a pouch with three single-use Spells (Understanding, Seeing, Release); 'be cautious in your use of magic'. Choose where to begin: Village of Glendoe (home), Haunted Waterfalls, Eldridge Forest.

steps.scene: Crystal ball: 1 Village of Glendoe, 2 Haunted Waterfalls, 3 Eldridge Forest, 4 rewind, 5 pouch.
steps.why: Begin at home, where Thayer once lived: the safest place to learn the land.
steps.outcome: Village of Glendoe: Thayer passes two villagers. Guild Hall / Outskirts.
DEATH. [Guildlord] 'A troublemaker if I ever saw one' -> jailed -> 'You have Died' (VMGM PGC 11 cell 7: 1 Continue, 2 Main Menu).

steps.scene: You have Died: 1 Continue, 2 Main Menu.
steps.outcome: Back at the village choice (VTS 2 cell 8). A death costs a retry, not the game.

[Beggar] 'Druce sent ya, didn't he? Just like the others. Well, I've heard stories of a Relic hidden in the forest in a Castle of Crystal. Now go! This place is dangerous!' -> 1 Village Square, 2 Timberland.

steps.why: The Relic is in the forest: Timberland.
steps.outcome: [Forester] 'Go away! Strangers aren't welcome!' [Woman] 'My son was your age when he learned that the Cold Fire, which burns on the marsh wastes, can destroy the landweres.' -> 1 Forest Path, 2 Hunting Ground, 3 Village of Glendoe, 4 Marsh Wastes.

steps.scene: 1 Forest Path, 2 Hunting Ground, 3 Village of Glendoe, 4 Marsh Wastes.
steps.why: Landweres likely guard the forest; fetch the Cold Fire that destroys them first.
steps.outcome: VTS 3. [Thayer] 'The marsh wastes! What a dreary place!... can hardly see where to step!' -> 1 Timberland, 2 Muddy Path, 3 Misty Path, 4 Foggy Path, and button 7: an unlabelled hotspot over the burning flames.

steps.scene: Marsh wastes with the Cold Fire burning; hotspot 7 over the flames.
steps.outcome: ITEM: Cold Fire into the pouch. [Druce's voice] 'Take care, my apprentice! Even the magic of the pouch has a limit.' 'The Relics! The Relics are important!' The hotspot is gone.

learned: 'You have Died' = VMGM PGC 11 cell 7; Continue returns to the last decision.
Some choices are unlabelled hotspots over objects in the scene (the Cold Fire): picking them up takes an item (CallSS VMGM pgc 7).
Subtitles carry the clues; a scene card must probe the whole cut or late-starting dialogue is lost.
